auntie_ethel_s_boon_strength.description: Gain +1 to a Strength ability score. Can be raised above 20.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_strength.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Strength)

auntie_ethel_s_boon_dexterity.description: Gain +1 to a Dexterity ability score. Can be raised above 20.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_dexterity.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Dexterity)

auntie_ethel_s_boon_constitutionh.description: Gain +1 to a Constitution ability score. Can be raised above 20.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_constitutionh.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Constitutionh)

auntie_ethel_s_boon_intelligence.description: Gain +1 to a Intelligence ability score. Can be raised above 20.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_intelligence.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Intelligence)

auntie_ethel_s_boon_wisdom.description: Gain +1 to a Wisdom ability score. Can be raised above 20.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_wisdom.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Wisdom)

auntie_ethel_s_boon_charisma.description: Gain +1 to a Charisma ability score. Can be raised above 20.
auntie_ethel_s_boon_charisma.name: Auntie Ethel's Boon (Charisma)

awakened.description: Use all illithid powers as a bonus action.
awakened.name: Awakened

boooal_s_benediction.description: Gain advantage on attack rolls against Bleeding targets.
boooal_s_benediction.name: BOOOAL's Benediction

brand_of_the_absolute.description: Allows the benefits from Absolute equipment and unlocks unique dialogue options when speaking to followers of the Absolute.
brand_of_the_absolute.name: Brand of the Absolute

find_familiar_scratch.description: Gain the ability to summon Scratch as a familiar while outside of camp. While summoned, Scratch will be able to uncover buried treasure.
find_familiar_scratch.name: Find Familiar: Scratch

find_familiar_quasit.description: Summon Shovel (or Basket, or Fork), the Cheeky Quasit.
find_familiar_quasit.name: Find Familiar: Quasit

loviatar_s_love.description: Gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and Wisdom saving throws if having 30% Hit Points or less.
loviatar_s_love.name: Loviatar's Love

speak_with_dead.description: Gain the passive feature Forbidden Knowledge, which grants a +1 to Wisdom saving throws and ability checks. The character with this bonus may also cast Speak with Dead once per long rest.
speak_with_dead.name: Speak with Dead

paid_the_price.description: Gain a +1 bonus to Intimidation checks, but also a disadvantage on Perception checks. Additionally, gain a disadvantage when attacking Hags.
paid_the_price.name: Paid the Price

survival_instinct.description: Gain the additional illithid power Survival Instinct, which allows the user to infuse a creature with psionic force, healing them if they reach 0 hit points.
survival_instinct.name: Survival Instinct

volo_s_ersatz_eye.description: Gain a permanent See Invisibility effect.
volo_s_ersatz_eye.name: Volo's Ersatz Eye

arabella_s_shadow_entangle.description: Gain the ability to entangle an Undead or Shadow Creature.
arabella_s_shadow_entangle.name: Arabella's Shadow Entangle

bardic_inspiration.description: Gain a charge of Bardic Inspiration that is stronger than usual (1d12). Usable once per long rest, and does not consume Bardic Inspiration charges.
bardic_inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration

githzerai_mind_barrier.description: Gain advantage on Intelligence saving throws.
githzerai_mind_barrier.name: Githzerai Mind Barrier

consumed_shadow_weave.description: Gale gains an additional level three spell slot, separate from normal spell slots. Recharges per long rest.
consumed_shadow_weave.name: Consumed Shadow Weave

potion_of_everlasting_vigour.description: Gain +2 Strength. Can be used to raise Strength above 20, and will remain after respeccing the character.
potion_of_everlasting_vigour.name: Potion of Everlasting Vigour

slayer_form.description: Gain the ability to transform into the Slayer once per long rest.
slayer_form.name: Slayer Form

summon_us.description: Summon Us, an intellect devourer, as a familiar.
summon_us.name: Summon Us

anointed_in_splendour.description: Gain +2 bonus to all Saving throw Saving throws.
anointed_in_splendour.name: Anointed in Splendour

partial_ceremorphosis.description: Gain access to tier 3 illithid powers, and automatically unlock all tier 1 illithid powers and the tier 3 illithid power Fly.
partial_ceremorphosis.name: Partial Ceremorphosis

danse_macabre.description: Gain 20 temporary hit points after a Long Rest. Remains active if The Tharchiate Codex is also used to obtain Danse Macabre.
danse_macabre.name: Danse Macabre

tasha_s_hideous_laughter.description: Gain the ability to cast Tasha's Hideous Laughter once per long rest.
tasha_s_hideous_laughter.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter

slayer_knowledge.description: Regarding the Slayer - gain advantage against Slayer abilities. When playing as the Dark Urge with the Slayer form unlocked, it also grants the Piercing Growl skill.
slayer_knowledge.name: Slayer Knowledge

sweet_stone_features.description: Gain a +1d4 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws.
sweet_stone_features.name: Sweet Stone Features

unstable_blood.description: The player character's blood is now highly flammable; if bleeding and creating a blood surface, it will explode on contact with fire.
unstable_blood.name: Unstable Blood

undead_ward.description: Accepting a romanced Vampire Ascendant Astarion results in the gain of the class action Bite (Vampire Spawn) as well as access to the buff from Circle of Bones.
undead_ward.name: Undead Ward

vampire_ascendant.description: Astarion gains class actions Ascendant Bite Ascendant Bite and Misty Escape Misty Escape, as well as an extra 1d10⁠1d10 necrotic damage on his weapon and unarmed attacks.
vampire_ascendant.name: Vampire Ascendant

resonance_stone.description: You and every entity within a 9m / 30ft radius will have Advantage on physical Ability checks, Disadvantage on mental Saving throws and Vulnerability to Psychic damage
resonance_stone.name: Resonance Stone

heart_ablaze.description: Heart Ablaze grants Karlach Immunity to Charmed effects.
heart_ablaze.name: Heart Ablaze
